metadata.title: Account | Bannerlord Coop
heading: Account
intro: Manage your connected accounts and membership.
status.unavailable: Account status is temporarily unavailable. We’ll check again automatically.
error.rateLimited: Too many account changes or synchronization is still catching up. Wait for updated status before trying again. Authorization expires within ten minutes. Unlink and existing server management remain available.
error.retry: The account is busy. Check the updated connection status before trying again. A new authorization replaces unfinished attempts.
error.lastIdentity: Discord is your only sign-in method. Connect another sign-in method before disconnecting it.
error.discordDisconnect: Discord could not be disconnected. Status updates automatically; try again once it is available. If the problem continues, contact support.
error.patreonDisconnect: Patreon could not be disconnected. Status updates automatically; wait for the current status before trying again.
error.discordRepair: Discord linking could not be completed. Check your current connection below before trying again. Your session may have changed, the request expired, or Discord may belong to another account. We never substitute sign-in for linking.
error.patreonAuthorization: Patreon authorization was cancelled or could not be completed. Check your current connection below, then connect or verify again if needed. A Patreon account can belong to only one website account.
connections.heading: Connected accounts
discord.optional: Discord is optional. You can set up and manage servers with this website account.
discord.identityUnavailable: Discord identity could not be confirmed. Waiting for updated account status.
patreon.benefits: Connect Patreon to check your membership benefits and server allowance.
membership.nonqualifying: No eligible membership benefits were found.
membership.reviewRequired: Your membership needs review. Contact support before trying again.
membership.verifyRequired: Verify your membership before creating a new server.
membership.syncUnavailable: Your server allowance could not be checked.
membership.expiry: You may need to verify your membership again before creating a new server. Existing servers aren’t automatically stopped when verification expires.
servers.heading: Your servers
servers.description: View and manage your existing servers.
disconnect.patreonExplanation: Disconnecting removes membership eligibility for new servers. Existing servers and administrative grants are not removed.
disconnect.discordExplanation: You will no longer be able to sign in with this Discord account. Discord-based access and new server setup may be unavailable until you reconnect. Use your other sign-in method to access this website account.
loading.label: Loading account
